mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_order (order_no, partner_id, partner_grade_code, status, total_amount) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{partnerId}, #{partnerGradeCode}, 'REQUESTED', #{totalAmount})

INSERT INTO sales_order_item (order_id, line_no, product_id, qty, unit_price, amount) VALUES
(#{orderId}, #{item.lineNo}, #{item.productId}, #{item.qty}, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.amount})
INSERT INTO order_status_history (order_id, from_status, to_status, reason, changed_by) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{reason}, #{changedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT i.line_no, i.product_id, p.sku, p.name AS product_name, i.qty, i.unit_price, i.amount FROM sales_order_item i JOIN product p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE i.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY i.line_no

SELECT h.from_status, h.to_status, h.reason, u.name AS changed_by_name, h.changed_at FROM order_status_history h JOIN app_user u ON u.id = h.changed_by WHERE h.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY h.changed_at, h.id
